```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)
library(arrow)
library(scales)
library(lubridate)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ==========================================
# GOOGLE TRENDS DATA PREP
# ==========================================
all_df <- read_csv("data/clean/clean_time_series_US_6.csv")

# Convert to tidy format and rename
tidy_df <- all_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(matcha, chai, cold_brew, mocha, refresher, psl, smoothie),
    names_to = "keyword",
    values_to = "interest"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    keyword = recode(
      keyword,
      matcha = "Matcha",
      chai = "Chai",
      cold_brew = "Cold Brew",
      mocha = "Mocha",
      refresher = "Refresher",
      psl = "Pumpkin Spice Latte",
      smoothie = "Smoothie"
    )
  )

growth_stats <- tidy_df |>
  mutate(year = year(time)) |>
  group_by(keyword, year) |>
  summarise(
    yearly_avg = mean(interest, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(keyword) |>
  summarise(
    first_avg = first(yearly_avg),
    last_avg = last(yearly_avg),
    pct_growth = if_else(
      first_avg > 0,
      ((last_avg - first_avg) / first_avg) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Growth stability matrix info
matrix_info <- tidy_df |>
  group_by(keyword) |>
  summarise(
    volatility = sd(interest, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(interest, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year_avg = mean(head(interest, 12), na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year_avg = mean(tail(interest, 12), na.rm = TRUE),
    growth_rate = (last_year_avg - first_year_avg) / first_year_avg,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

median_growth <- median(matrix_info$growth_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
median_volatility <- median(matrix_info$volatility, na.rm = TRUE)

# Monthly Seasonality Dataframe
monthly_avg <- tidy_df |>
  mutate(month = month(time, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(keyword, month) |>
  summarise(avg_interest = mean(interest, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Filter for recent trends (for Rolling Average plot)
trends_recent <- tidy_df |>
  filter(time >= as.Date("2016-01-01"))

# Rolling Average Dataframe
rol_avg <- trends_recent |>
  group_by(keyword) |>
  arrange(time) |>
  mutate(rolling_avg = rollmean(interest, k = 6, fill = NA))

# ==========================================
# TIKTOK DATA PREP
# ==========================================
tagged_data <- read_parquet("data/clean/clean_tiktok_data_tagged.parquet")

tag_counts <- tagged_data |>
  summarise(
    Starbucks = sum(commercial),
    `Powder Quality` = sum(traditional),
    `Flavors` = sum(flavor_innovation),
    `General Matcha` = sum(cafe_beverage)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "count"
  )

engagement_rates <- tagged_data |>
  select(
    engagement_rate,
    commercial,
    traditional,
    flavor_innovation,
    cafe_beverage
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      commercial,
      traditional,
      flavor_innovation,
      cafe_beverage
    ),
    names_to = "theme",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present) |>
  mutate(
    theme = recode(
      theme,
      commercial = "Starbucks",
      traditional = "Powder Quality",
      flavor_innovation = "Flavors",
      cafe_beverage = "General Beverage"
    )
  )

paired_stats <- tagged_data |>
  summarise(
    commercial_total = sum(commercial, na.rm = TRUE),
    overlap1 = sum(commercial & flavor_innovation, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_overlap1 = overlap1 / commercial_total * 100
  )
```


### Growth Stability Matrix
```{r}
ggplot(matrix_info, aes(x = growth_rate, y = volatility, label = keyword)) +
  # Quadrant Lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = median_volatility, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_growth, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45") +
  
  geom_point(size = 5, color = "#0e288e", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 5, point.padding = 0.5, box.padding = 0.8, min.segment.length = 0) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Growth-Stability of Beverages",
    subtitle = "Comparing long-term growth vs. search volume volatility",
    x = "Long-Term Growth Rate (First Year vs. Last Year)",
    y = "Volatility (Coefficient of Variation)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
```

## Row {height="42.5%"}

### Monthly Average Seasonal Line Plot
```{r}
# Data point for the label
label_data <- monthly_avg |> 
  filter(keyword == "Matcha", month == "Apr")

# Line plot
ggplot(monthly_avg, aes(x = month, y = avg_interest, color = keyword, group = keyword)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Monthly Search Interest by Beverage",
    subtitle = "Seasonality patterns across beverage trends",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Search Interest",
    color = "Beverage"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = "Growth in Matcha \ninterest during Spring"),
    nudge_y = 13,
    color = "gray20",
    size = 4,
    fontface = "italic",
    box.padding = 0.5
  ) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.7)  
  )
```

## Column {width="75%"}

### Category Frequency Bar Chart
```{r}
ggplot(tag_counts, aes(x = reorder(category, -count), y = count, fill = category)) + 
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) + 
  labs(
    title = "Content Theme Frequency on TikTok",
    subtitle = "Frequency of common matcha content themes across videos ",
    x = "Content Theme",
    y = "Number of Videos"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```

### Engagement Rate by Category Beeswarm Plot
```{r}
ggplot(engagement_rates, aes(x = reorder(theme, engagement_rate, FUN = median), y = engagement_rate, color = theme)) + 
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5, width = 0.2) + 
  # Black point to show median
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 15, size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.3)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Engagement Rate Distribution by Matcha Content Themes",
    subtitle = "Videos may belong to multiple themes. Black square indicates the median engagement rate. \nSample size varies per theme. \nEngagement is calculated by (Likes+Comments+Shares+Saves / Views)",
    x = "Content Theme",
    y = "Engagement Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```
